    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AddCommand
    AddCommand (add) reads StudyGroup from the reader and adds it to collection.
    AddIfMinCommand
    AddIfMinCommand (add_if_min) reads StudyGroup from the reader and adds it to the collection in case it less that minimal instance in the collection.
    ClearCommand
    ClearCommand (clear) clears the collection
    CollectionManager
    The itmo.semyonh.lab5.CollectionManager class is a central entity that controls the collection `data`, additional data related to that (like `initData`), and handles command execution, that affects underlying data or manager itself (data load/store to a file).
    Command
    Command interface describes command being used for manipulate itmo.semyonh.lab5.CollectionManager
    CommandManager
    CommandManager handles registration of itmo.semyonh.lab5.commands, their parsing and inline arguments parsing.
    ExecuteScriptCommand
    ExecuteScriptCommand (execute_script file_name) reads content of the script file and provide it as an input for the command parsing, and executes all itmo.semyonh.lab5.commands.
    ExitCommand
    ExitCommand (exit) exits the program
    HelpCommand
    HelpCommand (help) prints the description of all registered itmo.semyonh.lab5.commands.
    HistoryCommand
    HistoryCommand (history) prints last 7 itmo.semyonh.lab5.commands executed.
    InfoCommand
    InfoCommand (info) prints information about collection.
    Main
     
    MaxByCoordsCommand
    MaxByCoordsCommand (max_by_coordinates) prints any collection item that has maximal coordinates value.
    PrintFieldDescFormOfEducationCommand
    PrintFieldDescFormOfEducationCommand (print_field_descending_form_of_education) prints formOfEducation of all collection entries in descending order.
    PrintUniqueShouldBeExpelledCommand
    PrintUniqueShouldBeExpelledCommand (print_unique_should_be_expelled) prints all unique values of shouldBeExpelled field of all items in the collection.
    RemoveByIdCommand
    RemoveByIdCommand (remove_by_id id) removes collection entry that has id that was provided as an argument, if there are no such entry, does noting.
    RemoveGreaterCommand
    RemoveGreaterCommand (remove_greater) reads StudyGroup from the reader and removes all elements from collection, which are greater that read one.
    SaveCommand
    Represent a special case command.
    ShowCommand
    ShowCommand (show) prints all elements of the collection.
    UpdateCommand
    UpdateCommand (update id) reads StudyGroup from the reader, and replaces item with provided id in the collection with a new one.
